J. Andrew Cashman on behalf of the Maine Association of REALTORS�

Senator Curry, Representative Gere and members of the Joint Select Committee on Housing and Economic Development, my name is Andy Cashman. I am the Founder of Resolve Government Relations. The Maine Association of REALTORS� supports LD 845. The bill proposes a statewide Firsttime Home-buyer Program through the Finance Authority of Maine to assist first-time home buyers by providing access to affordable mortgages with low interest rates and low down payment requirements.
This bill would create an alternative pathway for the increasing number of first-time homebuyers being priced out of the current housing market. By providing first time buyers with more tools, they will be empowered in their pursuit of homeownership, which inspires a deep sense of personal pride and accomplishment. Real property ownership encourages savings and investment and contributes to economic stability and self-sufficiency. The more tools we can provide to future property owners, the better our housing market will be and our economy as a whole.
